description: For an almost disjoint family A, maximality is equivalent to every infinite subset of the naturals having infinite intersection with some member of A.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.maximal_iff_infinite_intersection (A : Set (Set ℕ))
  (hA : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.IsAlmostDisjoint A) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.IsMaximalAlmostDisjoint A ↔ ∀ (B : Set ℕ), B.Infinite → ∃ S ∈ A, (S ∩ B).Infinite
